risks.title: Dependence on IT systems and cyberattacks
risks.score_rationale: Risk placed at the beginning of section Item 1A (strong position). Intensive language: 'business and reputation could suffer' indicates material impact. Stable trend but cybersecurity category = high weighting in reporting standards. Absence of detailed mitigation suggests significant exposure.

risks.title: Volatility of raw material prices
risks.score_rationale: Risk detailed in the middle of the report (MD&A Item 7) with quantified data on corn, soybean, wheat. Moderate language ('may impact') but concrete exposure documented by price tables. Stable trend in 2025 but historically volatile. Macro weighting = high weight for food processing sector.

risks.title: Geopolitical and trade policy risks
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly mentioned in MD&A with references to Russia-Ukraine war and tariff changes. Cautious language ('uncertain and evolving') but recognition of exposure. Increasing trend: new mentions of tariffs and trade policies. Geopolitical weighting = high weight for international group.

risks.title: Foreign exchange rate fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified in MD&A with quantified impact: stronger British pound, weaker Mexican peso. Factual language without dramatic intensity. Stable trend but documented exposure. Macro weighting moderate as PPC has localized operations (less than 3% US exports).

risks.title: Rising labor costs and animal welfare expenses
risks.score_rationale: Risk detailed in MD&A with specific regional impacts (UK: 'increased labor costs and animal welfare costs'). Moderate language but recognition of growing exposure. Increasing trend: repeated mentions of producer retention costs. Industry weighting = high weight for sector.

risks.title: Obligations to reduce greenhouse gas emissions
risks.score_rationale: Explicit risk related to sustainability-linked bonds (1 billion USD). Quantified targets: -17.7% by 2025 and -30% by 2030 vs 2019. Factual language but binding contractual commitment. Stable trend but non-compliance risk. Environmental weighting = high post-ESG.

risks.title: Dividend distribution restrictions under debt agreements
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified in Item 5 with restrictive language: 'restrict, but do not prohibit'. Specific mentions of US Credit Facility and Europe Revolver Facility. Stable trend but relevant following authorization of $2 billion in special dividends. Credit weighting = moderate.

ai_positioning.summary: The company PPC does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
